name: hauksbee-ci
description: Run hauksbee-ci hardware checks on the open board: boot the firmware on the emulated PCB and assert rails, UART, and blink.
description_full:
A pcbnew action plugin that runs hauksbee-ci on the board you have open in KiCad and shows the pass/fail results in a dialog: does the rail come up, does the UART say hello, does the LED blink.

The plugin is deliberately thin. It discovers hauksbee-ci specs (*.toml) next to the board or in a sibling ci/ directory, shells out to the hauksbee-ci binary, parses the JUnit XML it writes, and renders a GREEN/RED verdict with each assertion's detail. All the simulation lives in the Rust runner.

Requires a hauksbee-ci binary: download a prebuilt release from the repository, put it on PATH or set HAUKSBEE_CI_BIN, or let the plugin offer to build it with cargo. See the repository README for spec examples and CI setup.
